comment: The two input range knobs are prevented from crossing: every sample the code sets the HIGH knob's minimum to the LOW value plus 0.05V and the LOW knob's maximum to HIGH minus 0.05V, so the input range can never be inverted, only the output range can. With nothing patched to the input the output is set to zero channels rather than 0V. The maker documents the module as a polyphonic remapper and the code bears that out: all channels are converted through one set of settings.
